name: Idrisid Caliphate
events: Abu 'Abdullah al-Shi'i leads the rebellion of the Kutama Berbers (a movement of the Shiʿite Fatimids)…
The Kutama tribe under Abu Abdallah al-Shi'i revolt against the Aghlabids.
The Berber Kutama tribesmen under Abdullah al-Mahdi Billah capture the cities of Kairouan and Raqqada.
The second rebellion in two years, of the Kutama tribesmen against the Fatimid Caliphate, occurs.
